name: Hamilton Lane Senior Credit Opportunities Securitize Fund
oneLiner: HLSCOPE is Hamilton Lane's SCOPE senior secured private-credit fund tokenized via Securitize for qualified purchasers, priced at NAV rather than $1.
collateral: Tokenized feeder exposure to Hamilton Lane Senior Credit Opportunities Fund (SCOPE), targeting floating-rate senior secured loans to private borrowers in sectors such as healthcare, information technology, and business services.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting tokenized feeder-fund share rather than a fixed $1 peg; qualified purchasers access monthly subscriptions and on-demand redemptions at the previous quarter's NAV per share through Securitize's digital process.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: HLSCOPE was first tokenized through Securitize on Polygon and is now tracked on Ethereum and Optimism as well. Public multichain evidence points to Wormhole-enabled interoperability, so the route is reviewed conservatively as an external lock/mint route.

jurisdiction.license: Delaware limited partnership; Rule 506(c) private placement; Investment Company Act Section 3(c)(7) exemption; qualified-purchaser access

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: HLSCOPE is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: HLSCOPE is a Securitize DSToken on Ethereum, Polygon, and Optimism. All three chains share the same EOA owner (0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee), confirmed EOA on all three chains. Polygon uses an EIP-1967 proxy; Optimism also uses a proxy. No permissionless mint route exists.

controls.label: HLSCOPE Securitize DSToken issuance surface (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295014, owner() = 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee (EOA confirmed, eth_getCode returned 0x). Implementation 0xa2f6ef3144753f31fcd728910b96a92bbbb462c9; DSToken exposes issueTokens issuance functions.

controls.label: HLSCOPE Securitize DSToken issuance surface (Polygon)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88323698, owner() = 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee (same EOA as Ethereum, confirmed). EIP-1967 proxy; implementation slot = 0x5e98857d4bd2b3569a87c0f226e2c961aae02e0b.

controls.label: HLSCOPE Securitize DSToken issuance surface (Optimism)
controls.evidence: At Optimism block 152795880, owner() = 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee (same EOA as Ethereum, confirmed). EIP-1967 proxy; implementation slot = 0x05eadc08ffd13ee7b1e28a883c4ce45e46a063ae.

controls.label: HLSCOPE token owner (EOA, all chains)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295014, eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA confirmed). Same address is owner on Polygon (block 88323698) and Optimism (block 152795880), also confirmed EOA on Polygon.

review.evidence: All three HLSCOPE deployments (Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism) return the same EOA owner 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee from owner(). EOA confirmed via eth_getCode (0x) on Ethereum and Polygon. Polygon and Optimism are EIP-1967 proxies of DSToken implementations; no proxy admin separate from owner. Polygon proxy admin slot (0xb531...) = 0x00 confirming no separate admin.

notices.title: Contract-priced fund token
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live price and market cap but little or no secondary-market volume; Pharos treats HLSCOPE as a NAV-priced fund share.
